settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free carbon-neutral shipping on every order. Try it for 30 nights — if it's not for you, return it for a full refund.

settings.heading: Care & cleaning
settings.content: Wipe the tank with a soft cloth weekly. A drop of white vinegar keeps the mist plate clear and the diffuser running like new.

settings.heading: How it works
settings.subheading: Three steps to a calmer space.

settings.title: Fill with water
settings.text: Pour clean water up to the fill line.

settings.title: Add a few drops
settings.text: Drop in your favourite essential oil blend.

settings.title: Breathe & unwind
settings.text: Tap once for a soft mist and warm glow.

settings.quote: I fall asleep so much faster now. The mist is silky and the lavender blend is heavenly.

settings.question: How long does one fill last?
settings.answer: Up to 10 hours on the low setting — enough for a full night.

settings.question: Which essential oils can I use?
settings.answer: Any pure, water-soluble essential oil. We recommend our Verdura blends.

settings.question: Is it safe overnight?
settings.answer: Yes — auto shut-off turns it off the moment the water runs low.

settings.heading: Love it, or your money back
settings.text: If you're not sleeping calmer within 30 nights, we'll refund every cent — and you can keep the oils on us.
